### Accessibility and behavior

- A real h3 heading names the panel section
- Subtitle and summary text remain visible beside the heading
- The panel is noninteractive

Role: `none`.

Accessible name: `heading` strategy targeting `h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6`.

### Compatibility

Mirrors renderClassificationPanel over renderPanelSection with data-panel-type=classification: title aliases title/label/heading/name (default Classification), subtitle aliases subtitle/description/metadata, and summary/text/body/emptyMessage fill the content area only without authored children. The saved-schema directives categoriesField, tagsField, metadataField and modeParameter are consumed by codegen and left unbound: the HTML renderer reads no categories, tags or mode, and its metadata alias is scalar subtitle text while metadataField names an object-typed field.
